scope: delivery reservation and customer usage; merchant inventory reservation

findings.deliveryFunding: 28 records tied to terminal orders; 14 CAPTURED and 14 RELEASED. No active reservations or DELIVERY_USAGE rows observed.
findings.inventory: No inventory reservation rows observed. Source schema is branch/order scoped and has no direct customer identifier.
findings.deletionGap: Customer delivery funding reservation/customer usage records in PlatformStaff do not have an explicit customer retention adapter. Preserve records; audit does not establish complete deletion coverage.
findings.limits: Bounded strongly consistent per-page reads, not an atomic cross-table snapshot. Empty observed inventory does not validate the production stock lifecycle.

next: Implement customer delivery funding retention preflight and archive policy without deleting financial evidence; verify live IAM before rollout.
